note: Canon Stands from Parts 3 to 7 for the claim board. 'stats' are Destructive Power, Speed, Range, Durability, Precision and Developmental Potential, from the JoJo wiki (jojowiki.com/Stand_Stats); ∅ is None and ? is unknown. 'about' is the Stand, 'ability' its Esoteric Ability. Evolved forms (Requiem, later ACTs, C-MOON, Made in Heaven, Love Train) belong to their base Stand. Keyed by claim name (case and punctuation ignored); 'aliases' are other names on the board.

Star Platinum.about: A towering humanoid fighter with unmatched strength, speed and precision.
Star Platinum.ability: Star Finger stretches its fingers to strike at range. Later it can stop time for a few seconds (Star Platinum: The World).

Magician's Red.about: A bird-headed humanoid wreathed in flame.
Magician's Red.ability: Creates and controls fire hot enough to melt steel, shaping it into crosses, ankhs and sensing flames (Life Detector).

Hermit Purple.about: Thorny purple vines that grow from the user’s hands.
Hermit Purple.ability: Spirit photography and divination: projects distant images onto cameras, TVs and maps. Can channel Hamon and bind foes.

Hierophant Green.about: A slender green humanoid that can unravel into long strings.
Hierophant Green.ability: Fires Emerald Splash, a barrage of energy gems. Its body unravels into tendrils to infiltrate and possess others, or set web traps.

Silver Chariot.about: A knight in silver armour armed with a rapier.
Silver Chariot.ability: Blinding sword speed. Shedding its armour makes it fast enough to leave afterimages. Its rapier tip can be fired as a projectile.

The Fool.about: A sand-made beast with a mask and wheels for feet.
The Fool.ability: Is made of sand: shapes itself into decoys, gliders and walls, and turns to sand to shrug off physical blows.

The World.about: A golden, heart-adorned humanoid with immense power.
The World.ability: Stops time for several seconds, letting only the user move. Its duration grows as the user’s body adapts.

Tower of Gray.ability: Moves faster than the eye can follow and tears out tongues with its needle-like mouth.

Dark Blue Moon.ability: Fights underwater: razor-sharp scales, whirlpools, and barnacles that drain the target’s strength.

Strength.ability: Merges with a ship and controls every part of it, trapping its passengers inside.

Ebony Devil.about: A small devilish creature that possesses a doll.
Ebony Devil.ability: Its power grows with the user’s grudge: the more he’s hurt, the stronger the doll becomes.

Yellow Temperance.about: A yellow, gelatinous mass worn like armour.
Yellow Temperance.ability: Disguises the user as anyone and consumes anything it touches. Absorbs physical attacks harmlessly.

Hanged Man.about: A mummified figure that exists only in reflections.
Hanged Man.ability: Lives inside reflections and jumps between reflective surfaces at the speed of light to attack.

Emperor.ability: A gun that fires Stand bullets whose paths the user can steer mid-flight.

Empress.about: A growth that emerges on the target’s body.
Empress.ability: Grows from a drop of blood on the victim into a separate, speaking creature that attacks them from their own body.

Wheel of Fortune.ability: Possesses a car and reshapes it: bursts through terrain, fires gasoline and climbs walls.

Justice.ability: Takes control of anyone with an open wound, puppeting the living and the dead with its fog.

Lovers.ability: Enters a person’s brain: any pain dealt to the user is multiplied and passed to the victim.

Sun.ability: Raises the surrounding temperature to scorching levels and fires heat beams.

Death Thirteen.about: A grim reaper with a scythe.
Death Thirteen.ability: Attacks sleepers inside a dream world it controls. Victims forget everything when they wake.

Judgement.ability: Grants wishes by creating clay copies of people. The copies attack the wisher.

High Priestess.about: A creature with a sharp-toothed maw.
High Priestess.ability: Turns into any mineral or metal object, from a razor to the sea floor, to attack from within.

Geb.about: A mass of water shaped like a hand.
Geb.ability: Controls water as a weapon, slicing at high speed over long range. The user tracks targets by sound.

Khnum.about: A face that overlays the user’s.
Khnum.ability: Changes the user’s face and body to look like anyone.

Tohth.ability: Predicts the near future in comic panels. Its predictions always come true, though not always as expected.

Anubis.ability: Possesses whoever draws it and learns every attack it sees, never losing to the same move twice. Can pass through objects.

Bastet.ability: Anyone who touches it becomes magnetized, growing stronger until metal objects crush them.

Sethan.ability: Anyone touched by its shadow regresses in age, losing their body and memories.

Osiris.ability: Takes the souls of anyone who loses a bet and admits defeat, sealing them in poker chips.

Horus.ability: Freezes moisture into ice projectiles, spikes and walls.

Atum.about: A tall humanoid with an hourglass-like head.
Atum.ability: Reads a person’s soul to learn their true answer to any yes or no question, and seals lost souls in dolls.

Tenore Sax.ability: Creates convincing illusions, turning a building into a maze.

Cream.about: A humanoid with a gaping mouth.
Cream.ability: Swallows itself and the user into a void that erases anything it passes through.

Crazy Diamond.about: A powerful humanoid in diamond-heart armour.
Crazy Diamond.ability: Restores anything it touches to a prior state, healing wounds and fixing objects. It can’t heal its own user.

Aqua Necklace.ability: Lives in water and vapour, entering targets through their mouths to attack from inside.

Bad Company.about: A miniature army of soldiers, tanks and helicopters.
Bad Company.ability: Commands a tiny army that fires real, scaled-down weapons and missiles in coordinated attacks.

Red Hot Chili Pepper.about: A reptilian humanoid made of electricity.
Red Hot Chili Pepper.ability: Travels through power lines, absorbing electricity to grow stronger. Can pull targets into the grid.

The Lock.ability: Locks onto a target’s guilt. The heavier the lock grows, the more guilt weighs them down.

Echoes.about: An ACT Stand that evolves through three forms.
Echoes.ability: ACT 1 makes sound effects stick to surfaces. ACT 2 turns words into physical effects. ACT 3 (Three Freeze) makes targets crushingly heavy.

Surface.ability: Becomes a perfect copy of a person, then forces them to mirror its movements.

Love Deluxe.ability: Gives the user control over her hair: it grows, binds and strangles.

Pearl Jam.about: Tiny Stands that live in food.
Pearl Jam.ability: Hides in cooking and heals ailments in whoever eats it, often violently.

Achtung Baby.ability: Turns the user and whatever she touches invisible.

Ratt.about: A cannon on a rat’s back.
Ratt.ability: Fires darts that melt flesh into a fused, organic mass.

Heaven's Door.about: A small humanoid from the user’s manga.
Heaven's Door.ability: Turns people into books: reads their memories and writes commands they must obey.

The Hand.about: A bulky humanoid with a symbol-marked right hand.
The Hand.ability: Its right hand erases anything it swipes, deleting space itself to pull targets closer.

Cinderella.ability: Changes body parts like faces and lips to change a person’s fate.

Atom Heart Father.ability: The user lives inside a photo and can trap others in the photograph’s space.

Boy II Man.ability: Steals a third of a target’s Stand with each won game of rock-paper-scissors.

Earth Wind and Fire.ability: The user shapeshifts into objects, from dice to a phone.

Highway Star.ability: Traps targets in an illusion room, then chases and drains their nutrients to heal the user.

Stray Cat.ability: Controls the air around it, firing invisible air bubbles and shields.

Super Fly.ability: Binds its user to the tower and reflects any attack on it back at the attacker.

Enigma.ability: Spots a target’s tell of fear, then seals them inside paper.

Cheap Trick.about: A creature on its host’s back.
Cheap Trick.ability: Attaches to a person’s back and talks others into killing them by looking at it.

Harvest.ability: Swarms of tiny Stands that gather items and inject substances like alcohol.

Killer Queen.ability: Turns anything it touches into a bomb. Sheer Heart Attack is a heat-seeking bomb; Bites the Dust loops time to kill whoever learns the secret.

Gold Experience.about: A golden humanoid with ladybug motifs.
Gold Experience.ability: Gives life to objects, turning them into plants and animals, and makes body parts. Requiem returns any action to zero.

Sticky Fingers.about: A blue-and-white humanoid with zipper motifs.
Sticky Fingers.ability: Places zippers on any surface to open, split or hide things inside, including the user’s own body.

Moody Blues.about: A humanoid with a digital timer.
Moody Blues.ability: Replays past events, re-enacting anyone’s actions within the scene.

Sex Pistols.ability: Six little Stands that ride and redirect the user’s bullets mid-flight.

Aerosmith.ability: A machine-gun plane with a CO2 radar that tracks breathing targets.

Purple Haze.about: A feral humanoid with capsule-studded fists.
Purple Haze.ability: Its fists hold capsules of a flesh-eating virus that kills within seconds when released.

Spice Girl.ability: Makes anything it touches soft and elastic, then unbreakable.

King Crimson.about: A red humanoid with a second face (Epitaph).
King Crimson.ability: Erases time so only the user moves through it, and Epitaph shows him the near future.

Black Sabbath.ability: Pierces anyone in its shadow with an Arrow; those without the will to survive die.

Soft Machine.ability: Deflates anything it stabs, including people.

Kraft Work.ability: Fixes anything it touches in place, stopping bullets mid-air.

Little Feet.ability: Shrinks whatever it cuts, including the user.

Man in the Mirror.about: A humanoid that lives in mirrors.
Man in the Mirror.ability: Pulls people into a mirror world, letting in only what the user allows.

Mr. President.ability: The turtle’s key opens a hidden room inside its shell.

The Grateful Dead.ability: Releases a gas that ages anyone whose body is warm.

Beach Boy.ability: Its line passes through walls and hooks anything it catches.

White Album.ability: Freezes everything around it, down to absolute zero.

Metallica.about: Tiny Stands inside the user’s body.
Metallica.ability: Controls the iron in blood, forming razors and needles inside the victim’s body.

Clash.about: A shark that lives in liquid.
Clash.ability: Moves through any liquid to attack from within it.

Talking Head.ability: Makes the target say the opposite of what they mean.

Notorious B.I.G.ability: Activates when the user dies, chasing and consuming anything that moves fastest.

Baby Face.about: A humanoid child raised by the user.
Baby Face.ability: Takes apart matter and rebuilds it into new forms. Its personality depends on how it was raised.

Green Day.ability: Spreads a flesh-eating mould onto anyone who moves to a lower height.

Oasis.about: A suit worn by the user.
Oasis.ability: Liquefies earth and solid matter so the user can swim through it.

Rolling Stones.ability: Senses who is fated to die soon and tries to give them a painless death.

Stone Free.about: A blue humanoid made of string.
Stone Free.ability: Unravels the user’s body into strings to bind, sense and fight at range.

Goo Goo Dolls.ability: Shrinks people to the size of a doll.

Whitesnake.about: A humanoid covered in DNA-like markings.
Whitesnake.ability: Strips Stands and memories into discs and creates illusions. Evolves into C-MOON (inverts gravity) and Made in Heaven (accelerates time).

Marilyn Manson.ability: Collects any debt a person owes after losing a bet, taking body parts if needed.

Jail House Lock.ability: Limits whoever is affected to remembering only three new things at a time.

Foo Fighters.ability: Controls and inhabits bodies with plankton, firing bullets made of plankton.

Weather Report.ability: Controls weather. Heavy Weather twists rainbows to turn people into snails.

Kiss.ability: Its stickers create a copy of whatever they’re on. Peeling the sticker smashes the copies back together.

Burning Down the House.ability: Manifests the ghosts of objects, creating a hidden room only the user can find.

Bohemian Rhapsody.ability: Brings fictional characters into reality, forcing people into their stories.

Sky High.ability: Commands Rods, flying creatures that steal body heat.

Under World.ability: Digs up the memories of the earth, replaying past events around its victims.

Manhattan Transfer.ability: A floating relay that redirects the user’s bullets and senses air currents.

Highway to Hell.ability: When the user tries to kill himself, he takes another person with him.

Diver Down.about: A humanoid that dives into objects.
Diver Down.ability: Phases into objects and people to store kinetic energy or alter their insides.

Yo-Yo Ma.ability: A friendly butler that secretly drips acid on its target.

Green, Green Grass of Home.ability: Shrinks space, making a target tiny whenever they approach the user.

Jumpin' Jack Flash.ability: Removes gravity in an area and turns objects into projectiles.

Limp Bizkit.ability: Raises the dead as invisible zombies.

Survivor.ability: Makes people extremely aggressive and shows them where their opponents are strongest.

Planet Waves.ability: Pulls meteors from the sky to strike the user’s enemies.

Dragon's Dream.ability: Shows the most fortunate and unlucky directions for anyone, using feng shui.

Tusk.about: An ACT Stand that evolves through four forms.
Tusk.ability: Spins the user’s fingernails into bullets. Later ACTs fire spinning holes and, at ACT 4, infinite rotation.

Scary Monsters.ability: Turns the user and others into dinosaurs, spreading the virus to anyone wounded.

Dirty Deeds Done Dirt Cheap.ability: Travels between parallel worlds by getting caught between objects. Love Train deflects misfortune onto others.

Mandom.ability: Rewinds time by six seconds when the user turns the watch.

Oh! Lonesome Me.ability: Splits the user’s body along a rope and moves it along the line.

Wired.ability: Hooks spread out like fishing lines to reel in and wound targets.

Tomb of the Boom 1 2 3.about: A magnetism Stand shared by a family.
Tomb of the Boom 1 2 3.ability: Turns iron in the body into magnets that tear people apart.

Hey Ya!.ability: Points out the user’s luck and gives him the confidence to seize it.

In a Silent Way.ability: Turns onomatopoeia into physical objects that trigger when touched.

Ball Breaker.ability: Ages and withers anything the Golden Spin of a Steel Ball strikes.

Cream Starter.ability: Sprays flesh to heal wounds, disguise faces or suffocate.

Catch the Rainbow.ability: Stops raindrops in mid-air to walk on them or slice targets.

Tubular Bells.ability: Turns metal into balloon animals that home in on targets.

20th Century BOY.ability: Makes the user invulnerable while he stays still.

Civil War.ability: Brings back what people abandoned in the past to torment them.

Chocolate Disco.ability: Lays a grid on the ground and teleports anything to any square.

Boku no Rhythm wo Kiitekure.ability: Turns objects into bombs set off by a pin.

Sugar Mountain.ability: A tree that grants riches to those who spend them within a day.

Ticket to Ride.ability: Twists fate to protect the user from harm.

TATOO YOU!.ability: Lets the users pass through one another’s tattoos.
